params.1273: Kill a giant rat in each of the melee combat stances (Aggressive, Defensive, Controlled and Accurate).
params.1274: Not all weapons offer every type of fighting stance; you may need to acquire others.
params.1275: Rats are a common sight around Lumbridge and in Lumbridge Swamp.
params.1276: Make sure your foe is entirely dead before changing combat stance!
params.2225: The style you fight in affects the experience you gain. It also has an effect on your effective combat levels.
